title: Functorial filtered-complex page models from page two
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be an abelian category. A functorial filtered-complex page model from page two is a functor from filtered cochain complexes and filtration-preserving maps [def-sp-filtration] to cohomological spectral sequences starting at page two [def-sp-spectral-sequence], together with, for every filtered complex $(K,F)$, $p,q\in\mathbb Z$ and $r\ge2$, the canonical comparison $\phi:F^pK/F^{p+r}K\to F^{p-r+1}K/F^{p+1}K$ and an isomorphism $E_r^{p,q}\cong\operatorname{im}(H^{p+q}(\phi))$ [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients]. The comparison commutes with the quotient projections and filtration inclusion. For each filtered map, the induced quotient maps commute with those projections and restrictions, and under the page isomorphisms its page map is the image map of the resulting cohomology square. Its differential sends a filtered cycle representative $x$ to the class of $dx$, expressed by the projection to the target quotient and its homology.
